svg.title: LXDiN LXD solid versus negative-space: founder comparison board

g.aria-label: TWO ORIGINAL VECTOR TREATMENTS · FOUNDER SELECTION REVIEW
Most legible L, X and D at normal identity sizes.
The X is the lock body; a true keyhole knockout.
Stronger compact silhouette and solid housing.
LXD is cut through the body; no background matte.
RECOMMENDATION: A as the primary identity. B is a credible compact alternate. Founder selection is still required.
